cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Validation Engineer III to join our team.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Lead or support cleaning, equipment, utilities, sterilization and/or autoclave qualification due to equipment modifications for tech transfers, Make-Assess-Release (MAR) or routine re-qualification activities. Ensure the timely completion of Cleaning Monitoring as well as validation team assignments. Any deviations, anomalies or schedule impacting items are to be reported to site management. This position provides trained technical resources for the development and execution of validation protocols in accordance with [Company name masked] and global procedures. The person will maintain up-to-date training status in the [Product name masked] (or equivalent) system. Author and review qualification protocols, engineering change orders, SOP changes, Engineering commissioning and turnover packages. Approval support of any qualification protocols will require approval of the site Validation as well as Quality Review Planned/Unplanned events and provide initial assessment for validation lead. Review of lifecycle documents for migration into new electronic system as well as for additional changes for MAR, Tech transfer. Responsible for on-time completion of validation activities according to overall current manufacturing schedule. Ensure coordination of Validation requirements with Quality, Manufacturing & Engineering. Ensure the integration of environmental health, safety, and security into the business processes, systems and programs while reporting safety and environmental incidents including injuries, illnesses, and safety suggestions within one's functional area. Foster a positive safety culture in which no one gets hurt.
This position provides resources for the controlled collection, assessment and reporting of scientific validation or study data in support of validation of processes. The data will be analyzed using algebraic and/or statistical methods to verify adherence to predetermined and approved process criteria. Reports will be written to communicate the outcome of the studies and/or validations. This position will provide sampling and inspection support for process equipment as part of the validation execution process. As such, the person must be trained on sampling and inspection procedures; and may be called upon to provide training for others as needed.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
BA/BS in Engineering or Life Sciences
5–7 Years of relevant validation engineer experience
Expert in current validation requirements and FDA expectations of facility, equipment, and computer validation
Ability to manage and track validation progress in required detail with data basis and schedules
Preferred Requirements
Ability to establish and maintain good relationships with various site functional groups as well as external validation contractors and consultants
Excellent teamwork skills, communication and problem solving skills

cond_0194.responsibilities:

Lead cleaning, equipment, utilities, sterilization and/or autoclave qualification due to equipment modifications for tech transfers, Make-Assess-Release (MAR) or routine re-qualification activities. Drive the timely completion of Cleaning Monitoring as well as validation team assignments. Report any deviations, anomalies or schedule-impacting items to site management. Maintain up-to-date training status in the [Product name masked] (or equivalent) system. Author and review qualification protocols, engineering change orders, SOP changes, engineering commissioning and turnover packages. Execute approval support of any qualification protocols, including approval of the site Validation as well as Quality Review Planned/Unplanned events, and deliver initial assessment for validation lead. Review lifecycle documents for migration into new electronic system as well as for additional changes for MAR and Tech transfer. Own on-time completion of validation activities according to the overall current manufacturing schedule. Direct coordination of Validation requirements with Quality, Manufacturing and Engineering. Ensure the integration of environmental health, safety, and security into business processes, systems and programs while reporting safety and environmental incidents including injuries, illnesses, and safety suggestions within one's functional area. Champion a positive safety culture in which no one gets hurt.
This position leads the controlled collection, assessment and reporting of scientific validation or study data in support of validation of processes. Analyze data using algebraic and/or statistical methods to verify adherence to predetermined and approved process criteria. Author reports to communicate the outcome of studies and/or validations. Direct sampling and inspection support for process equipment as part of the validation execution process. Maintain training on sampling and inspection procedures and take ownership of training others as needed.
cond_0206.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
5–7 Years of relevant validation engineer experience
BA/BS in Engineering or Life Sciences
Expert in current validation requirements and FDA expectations of facility, equipment, and computer validation
Ability to manage and track validation progress in required detail with databases and schedules
Preferred Requirements
Ability to establish and maintain good relationships with various site functional groups as well as external validation contractors and consultants
Excellent teamwork, communication, and problem-solving skills
cond_0206.values: We value work that reflects care for people and consideration for its wider impact. We aim to make decisions in ways that are responsible, fair, and respectful.

This role involves leading or supporting cleaning, equipment, utilities, sterilization and/or autoclave qualification due to equipment modifications for tech transfers, Make-Assess-Release (MAR) or routine re-qualification activities. You will regularly connect with Quality, Manufacturing, and Engineering teams, and stay in close contact with site management to flag deviations, anomalies, or schedule-impacting items as they arise.
cond_0249.responsibilities:
Lead or support cleaning, equipment, utilities, sterilization and/or autoclave qualification for tech transfers, MAR, or routine re-qualification activities.
Ensure timely completion of Cleaning Monitoring and validation team assignments.
Actively communicate any deviations, anomalies, or schedule-impacting items to site management.
Provide trained technical resources for the development and execution of validation protocols in accordance with [Company name masked] and global procedures.
Maintain up-to-date training status in the [Product name masked] (or equivalent) system.
Author and review qualification protocols, engineering change orders, SOP changes, engineering commissioning and turnover packages.
Support approval of qualification protocols, including Quality Review of Planned/Unplanned events, and provide initial assessment for validation lead.
Review lifecycle documents for migration into new electronic systems and for additional changes for MAR and tech transfer.
Ensure on-time completion of validation activities according to the overall current manufacturing schedule.
Coordinate daily with Quality, Manufacturing, and Engineering to align on validation requirements.
Integrate environmental health, safety, and security into business processes, systems, and programs; report safety and environmental incidents including injuries, illnesses, and safety suggestions within your functional area.
Foster a positive safety culture in which no one gets hurt.
Collect, assess, and report scientific validation or study data in support of process validation.
Analyze data using algebraic and/or statistical methods to verify adherence to predetermined and approved process criteria.
Write reports to communicate the outcome of studies and/or validations.
Provide sampling and inspection support for process equipment as part of validation execution; train others on sampling and inspection procedures as needed.
cond_0249.requirements:
5–7 Years of relevant validation engineer experience
BA/BS in Engineering or Life Sciences
Expert in current validation requirements and FDA expectations of facility, equipment, and computer validation
Ability to establish and maintain good working relationships with various site functional groups as well as external validation contractors and consultants
Ability to manage and track validation progress in required detail with databases and schedules
Excellent teamwork, communication, and problem-solving skills

Lead or support cleaning, equipment, utilities, sterilization and/or autoclave qualification due to equipment modifications for tech transfers, Make-Assess-Release (MAR) or routine re-qualification activities. Coordinate with the team on cleaning, equipment, utilities, sterilization, and/or autoclave qualification due to equipment modifications for tech transfers, Make-Assess-Release (MAR), or routine re-qualification activities.
Help ensure the timely completion of Cleaning Monitoring as well as validation team assignments.
Report any deviations, anomalies, or schedule-impacting items to site management.
Work with cross-functional partners to develop and execute validation protocols in accordance with [Company name masked] and global procedures.
Maintain up-to-date training status in the [Product name masked] (or equivalent) system.
Collaborate on authoring and reviewing qualification protocols, engineering change orders, SOP changes, engineering commissioning, and turnover packages.
Support approval of qualification protocols in coordination with site Validation and Quality Review for Planned/Unplanned events, and assist the validation lead with initial assessments.
Review lifecycle documents for migration into a new electronic system and for additional changes related to MAR and Tech Transfer.
Work with Quality, Manufacturing, and Engineering to coordinate Validation requirements and help ensure on-time completion of validation activities according to the current manufacturing schedule.
Support the integration of environmental health, safety, and security into business processes, systems, and programs; share responsibility for reporting safety and environmental incidents including injuries, illnesses, and safety suggestions within the functional area.
Contribute to a positive safety culture in which no one gets hurt.
Support the controlled collection, assessment, and reporting of scientific validation or study data for process validation.
Help analyze data using algebraic and/or statistical methods to verify adherence to predetermined and approved process criteria.
Contribute to writing reports that communicate the outcome of studies and/or validations.
Provide sampling and inspection support for process equipment as part of validation execution; assist in training others on sampling and inspection procedures as needed.

Minimum Requirements
5–7 Years of relevant validation engineer experience
BA/BS in Engineering or Life Sciences
Expert in current validation requirements and FDA expectations of facility, equipment, and computer validation

Preferred Requirements
Established ability to build and maintain good relationships with various site functional groups as well as external validation contractors and consultants
Strong teamwork, communication, and problem-solving skills

cond_0335.intro: We are looking for a Validation Engineer III to join our team.
cond_0335.responsibilities:
Lead or support cleaning, equipment, utilities, sterilization and/or autoclave qualification due to equipment modifications for tech transfers, Make-Assess-Release (MAR) or routine re-qualification activities. Ensure the timely completion of Cleaning Monitoring as well as validation team assignments. Any deviations, anomalies or schedule impacting items are to be reported to site management. This position provides trained technical resources for the development and execution of validation protocols in accordance with [Company name masked] and global procedures. The person will maintain up-to-date training status in the [Product name masked] (or equivalent) system. Author and review qualification protocols, engineering change orders, SOP changes, Engineering commissioning and turnover packages. Approval support of any qualification protocols will require approval of the site Validation as well as Quality Review Planned/Unplanned events and provide initial assessment for validation lead. Review of lifecycle documents for migration into new electronic system as well as for additional changes for MAR, Tech transfer. Responsible for on-time completion of validation activities according to overall current manufacturing schedule. Ensure coordination of Validation requirements with Quality, Manufacturing & Engineering. Ensure the integration of environmental health, safety, and security into the business processes, systems and programs while reporting safety and environmental incidents including injuries, illnesses, and safety suggestions within one's functional area. Foster a positive safety culture in which no one gets hurt.
This position provides resources for the controlled collection, assessment and reporting of scientific validation or study data in support of validation of processes. The data will be analyzed using algebraic and/or statistical methods to verify adherence to predetermined and approved process criteria. Reports will be written to communicate the outcome of the studies and/or validations. This position will provide sampling and inspection support for process equipment as part of the validation execution process. As such, the person must be trained on sampling and inspection procedures; and may be called upon to provide training for others as needed.
cond_0335.requirements:
Minimum 7 years of demonstrated expertise in validation engineering
Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Life Sciences required; advanced degree strongly preferred
Advanced knowledge of current validation requirements and FDA expectations of facility, equipment, and computer validation

Strong written and verbal communication abilities

This role involves leading or supporting cleaning, equipment, utilities, sterilization and/or autoclave qualification due to equipment modifications for tech transfers, Make-Assess-Release (MAR) or routine re-qualification activities. You will regularly connect with Quality, Manufacturing, and Engineering teams, and stay in close contact with site management to flag deviations, anomalies, or schedule-impacting items as they arise.
cond_0447.responsibilities:
Lead or support cleaning, equipment, utilities, sterilization and/or autoclave qualification for tech transfers, MAR, or routine re-qualification activities.
Ensure timely completion of Cleaning Monitoring and validation team assignments.
Actively communicate any deviations, anomalies, or schedule-impacting items to site management.
Provide trained technical resources for the development and execution of validation protocols in accordance with [Company name masked] and global procedures.
Maintain up-to-date training status in the [Product name masked] (or equivalent) system.
Author and review qualification protocols, engineering change orders, SOP changes, engineering commissioning and turnover packages.
Support approval of qualification protocols, including Quality Review of Planned/Unplanned events, and provide initial assessment for validation lead.
Review lifecycle documents for migration into new electronic systems and for additional changes for MAR and tech transfer.
Ensure on-time completion of validation activities according to the overall current manufacturing schedule.
Coordinate daily with Quality, Manufacturing, and Engineering to align on validation requirements.
Integrate environmental health, safety, and security into business processes, systems, and programs; report safety and environmental incidents including injuries, illnesses, and safety suggestions within your functional area.
Foster a positive safety culture in which no one gets hurt.
Collect, assess, and report scientific validation or study data in support of process validation.
Analyze data using algebraic and/or statistical methods to verify adherence to predetermined and approved process criteria.
Write reports to communicate the outcome of studies and/or validations.
Provide sampling and inspection support for process equipment as part of validation execution; train others on sampling and inspection procedures as needed.
cond_0447.requirements:
5–7 Years of relevant validation engineer experience
BA/BS in Engineering or Life Sciences
Expert in current validation requirements and FDA expectations of facility, equipment, and computer validation
Ability to establish and maintain good working relationships with various site functional groups as well as external validation contractors and consultants
Ability to manage and track validation progress in required detail with databases and schedules
Excellent teamwork, communication, and problem-solving skills

Lead or support cleaning, equipment, utilities, sterilization and/or autoclave qualification due to equipment modifications for tech transfers, Make-Assess-Release (MAR) or routine re-qualification activities. Ensure the timely completion of Cleaning Monitoring as well as validation team assignments. Any deviations, anomalies or schedule impacting items are to be reported to site management. This position provides trained technical resources for the development and execution of validation protocols in accordance with [Company name masked] and global procedures. The person will maintain up-to-date training status in the [Product name masked] (or equivalent) system. Author and review qualification protocols, engineering change orders, SOP changes, Engineering commissioning and turnover packages. Approval support of any qualification protocols will require approval of the site Validation as well as Quality Review Planned/Unplanned events and provide initial assessment for validation lead. Review of lifecycle documents for migration into new electronic system as well as for additional changes for MAR, Tech transfer. Responsible for on-time completion of validation activities according to overall current manufacturing schedule. Ensure coordination of Validation requirements with Quality, Manufacturing & Engineering. Ensure the integration of environmental health, safety, and security into the business processes, systems and programs while reporting safety and environmental incidents including injuries, illnesses, and safety suggestions within one's functional area. Foster a positive safety culture in which no one gets hurt.
This position provides resources for the controlled collection, assessment and reporting of scientific validation or study data in support of validation of processes. The data will be analyzed using algebraic and/or statistical methods to verify adherence to predetermined and approved process criteria. Reports will be written to communicate the outcome of the studies and/or validations. This position will provide sampling and inspection support for process equipment as part of the validation execution process. As such, the person must be trained on sampling and inspection procedures; and may be called upon to provide training for others as needed.
cond_0479.requirements:
Minimum 7 years of demonstrated expertise in validation engineering
Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Life Sciences required; advanced degree strongly preferred
Advanced knowledge of current validation requirements and FDA expectations of facility, equipment, and computer validation
Proven track record of establishing and maintaining effective relationships with various site functional groups as well as external validation contractors and consultants
Strong command of managing and tracking validation progress in required detail with data basis and schedules
Exceptional teamwork, communication, and problem-solving skills
Strong written and verbal communication abilities
